The specification is internally rich but structurally repetitive: each subsection in 1.x appends the same crash/evidence question, and each subsection in 2.x appends the same stale-peer question. That repetition is not merely stylistic; it creates ambiguity about whether the repeated question is a local invariant, a cross-cutting requirement, or a placeholder for missing detail. A stronger document would separate shared crash-recovery and epoch-validation rules from per-domain invariants, then state which sections inherit them and which override them.
